description: This file defines functions and types for resolving Telegram bot tokens from various sources such as environment variables, configuration files, and secret files within a larger OpenClaw project. It includes logic for handling account-specific configurations and fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: resolveTelegramToken
methods.description: Resolves the Telegram bot token by checking account-specific token files, configuration, environment variables, and fallback logic, returning the token and its source.
